cases.customer_question: Should a product using a qualified MDBT42V module be registered using the Bluetooth v4.2 qualification or the successor Bluetooth v5.0 qualification?
question_variants: Can a product based on MDBT42V use the v5.0 registration?
Should I choose the older or newer module qualification?
Is Bluetooth v5.0 registration allowed when the module also has a v4.2 qualification?
Which module qualification should be referenced for registration?
What is the recommended qualification version for a reused module?
cases.actual_issue: Selecting the most appropriate qualification reference when a Bluetooth module has both an older qualification registration and a newer successor qualification registration available for reuse.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Some Bluetooth modules have multiple qualified registrations corresponding to different Bluetooth specification versions. A product using the module may be eligible to reference either qualification. Choosing the newer qualified registration can provide a more current qualification basis when permitted by the implementation.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant identified that the module had both a Bluetooth v4.2 qualification and a successor Bluetooth v5.0 qualification. Because the customer's product was eligible to use the newer registration path, the consultant recommended using the v5.0 qualification reference rather than the older v4.2 registration.
cases.decision_logic: When multiple valid qualification references exist for the same module, preference should be given to the newer eligible qualification registration if it accurately represents the implementation and is accepted for the intended registration path.
cases.final_recommendation: Evaluate all available module qualification references and use the newest eligible qualification registration that correctly matches the product implementation.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Selecting an outdated qualification reference may limit future flexibility and result in use of a less current qualification basis when a newer valid option is available.
